high_level_description: This image captures a view of a railway track system with multiple parallel tracks stretching into the distance. The foreground features a concrete barrier or wall running alongside the tracks, which appears to be part of a bridge or overpass. The tracks are surrounded by gravel and some greenery, indicating a mix of urban and slightly rural surroundings. In the mid-ground, there is a yellow billboard with text that reads "FACILIDADES" (Spanish for "facilities") and other smaller text that is not clearly legible due to the angle and focus.
